echoParts: that everyone who believes in Him
verseText: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up, that everyone who believes in Him may have eternal life.
meaning: God told Moses to lift up a bronze snake so that people who had been bitten by a snake could look at it and live. It was a picture of how Jesus would be lifted up on the cross to save us from sin.

recall.question: What did Moses lift up in the wilderness?

meaning.question: How does that story point to Jesus?
choices: He would be lifted up so believers have life
He would become a king in Egypt

application.prompt: Look to Jesus with faith and thank Him for being lifted up on the cross to save sinners.
